products.name: Cerebras
products.note: Wafer-scale AI compute; inference API; on-prem options; high-performance computing

profile_text.body:
Cerebras is a hardware and infrastructure company built around its wafer-scale chip technology. Its flagship product, the CS-4, is described by the company as a rack-scale solution that delivers up to 30x faster inference than GPUs and is positioned as the world's fastest infrastructure for frontier AI. The company offers its compute through an inference API as well as on-premises deployments.

Cerebras's customer base, as described on its site, includes OpenAI, GSK, Notion, and LiveKit, each citing inference speed and low latency as the primary reasons for the partnership. GSK describes using Cerebras to run a cancer-drug response prediction model many hundreds of times faster than on a conventional GPU, while Notion references the platform for real-time enterprise search features. The company also describes a hybrid inference architecture in which workloads are split across its CS-3 chip and AWS Trainium, connected via EFA, producing inference the company characterizes as an order of magnitude faster than existing alternatives.

The site's held facts confirm Cerebras has an active profile on theworldofai.org, categorized under Chat and General LLMs with a focus on wafer-scale AI compute, inference API access, and high-performance computing. No litigation, SEC filings, MCP servers, or patent records are present in the held data.
